think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range. 2) Check PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change the knob’s meaning (disable/auto/ignore). 3) If such a sentinel exists and causes qualitatively different behavior than the normal ordered numeric effect, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). 4) Otherwise, classify as non-special.
